exposure: Degree of placental separation from the decidua (>50% and <50%)
cohort: 100 women who presented with abruptio placentae at the Pretoria Academic Complex over a one-year period
finding: Known risk factors for abruptio placentae were largely absent in the study cohort, and women with greater than 50% placental separation were more likely to experience a woody hard abdomen and postpartum haemorrhage.
mod_finding: 61% of women with abruptio placentae had a caesarean delivery, while 37% had a vaginal delivery.
